translation.text: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: Master of the Day of Judgment.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: It is You we worship, and upon You we call for help.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: Guide us to the straight path.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

verses.canonicalText: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

translation.text: The path of those You have blessed, not of those against whom there is anger, nor of those who are misguided.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

verses.canonicalText: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

translation.text: Have you considered him who denies the religion?
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: It is he who mistreats the orphan.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: So woe to those who pray.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: Those who are heedless of their prayers.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: Those who put on the appearance.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: And withhold the assistance.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

verses.canonicalText: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

translation.text: Say, “He is Allah, the One.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: Allah, the Absolute.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: He begets not, nor was He begotten.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: And there is nothing comparable to Him.”
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

verses.canonicalText: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ

translation.text: Say, “I take refuge with the Lord of Daybreak.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: From the evil of what He created.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: And from the evil of the darkness as it gathers.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: And from the evil of those who practice sorcery.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: And from the evil of an envious when he envies.”
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

verses.canonicalText: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ

translation.text: Say, “I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: The King of mankind.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: The God of mankind.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: From the evil of the sneaky whisperer.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: Who whispers into the hearts of people.
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission

translation.text: From among jinn and among people.”
translation.name: ClearQuran (Allah Edition)
translation.license: CC BY-ND 4.0 with additional formatting permission
